justifications.durability: the new case drives the real store, the real flight resolution and the real gate refusal, so reverting the config resolution reddens it rather than leaving it green; the collapse keeps the predicate's three-value contract asserted by the two helper callers.

justifications.fit: one fit defect: the new case reassigns the monkeypatch fixture to its own None return; otherwise the additions follow the module's lazy-import and single-reader idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delta is the review-response commit for the significant-change node: it makes the gate read the configured threshold (the exact promise flight.py and the fragment state), collapses the two coverage functions into the one predicate §21 and §22 share, and removes the plan-section citation and the stale fragment counts; every hunk serves the node's stated goal.
justifications.reuse: the delta deletes the duplicate _review_coverage forwarder and the restating _plan_review_change_threshold, reads its range through the shared REVIEW_OWNED_KEYS shape check, and reuses the flight accessor and flight.resolve instead of a second range test or resolution path.
